This preview uses your saved browser draft. The main website changes only after you export and install your content pack.

When you’re ready.

  1. Choose Save & preview to check the photos and contact links.
  2. Choose Download content pack.
  3. Unzip it, then copy content.js and the assets folder into the website’s dist folder. Replace the existing content.js file.
  4. Refresh the main website. Keep the originals folder for your records.

You can also send the content pack here and ask me to apply it. Export before clearing browser data or changing devices.
